sizeConversionEvidence: Burton women's conversion chart: US 5/6/6.5/7/7.5/8/8.5/9/9.5/10/11 maps respectively to EU 35/36.5/37/38/39/40/40.5/41/41.5/42/43, UK 3/4/4.5/5/5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5/8/9, Mondo 22/23/23.5/24/24.5/25/25.5/26/26.5/27/28. Model-specific US size selectors differ; only selector-listed sizes were seeded.

bindingCompatibility.mapping: Each model-listed women's boot size maps to one women's Step On binding size without overlap. Burton says Step On boots are only compatible with Step On bindings. Nitro's official guide separately states Nitro Step On bindings work with all Step On boots and requires women boots to be paired with women bindings; the Nitro women's chart has the same US 5–6 / 6.5–8.5 / 9–11 S/M/L ranges. This supports the cross-brand pairing from Nitro's side, but boots and bindings must still be physically checked for full engagement.
bindingCompatibility.systemFitWarnings: Nitro's Step On guide states the system is size- and gender-specific and warns against mixing men's and women's boots/bindings. It also requires boot and binding size confirmation and a physical connection check before riding.
